evals.prompt:
Red team this AI consulting website copy and tell me why it won't convert:

Headline: Transforming businesses with intelligent AI solutions
Subheadline: We help companies leverage cutting-edge artificial intelligence to drive growth and operational efficiency.
Services: AI Strategy, Machine Learning, Process Automation, AI Training
CTA: Contact Us
About: Our team of experts has years of experience delivering AI solutions across industries.

We're targeting operations managers at manufacturing companies in Brazil. Pre-launch, 3 pilot clients done, no case studies published yet.
evals.expected_output: Adversarial critique identifying specific failures in hero copy, ICP clarity, offer design, jargon, missing proof, and unaddressed objections. Must include specific rewrite suggestions for headline, subheadline, and CTA.

evals.prompt:
Audit my startup homepage before launch. Here's everything about my company:

Name: FlowAI (fictional)
What we do: WhatsApp automation for small retail businesses in Mexico — automated order confirmations, inventory alerts, customer service bots
Target: Owner-operators of small retail stores (5-50 employees) who use WhatsApp to manage orders
Offer: MX$299/month subscription (after a free 2-week trial)
Currently: Pre-launch, no clients yet, but have a working product
Competitors: We think it's mainly manual WhatsApp management and maybe Twilio-based DIY solutions
Main concern: Is our positioning clear enough and will the trial CTA convert?
evals.expected_output: Full audit including ICP analysis (owner-operator vs. employee split), offer evaluation (subscription pricing for this ICP), competitive assessment of WhatsApp automation landscape in Mexico, specific headline/CTA recommendations, and launch readiness score out of 60.

evals.prompt: I haven't built my website yet. Company: DataMente. We help retail companies in Brazil automate their inventory reporting using AI. We serve operations directors at retail chains with 10-50 stores. Main offer: a 6-week implementation sprint. Two clients so far, no documented case studies. Audit my positioning before I write a single word of copy.
evals.expected_output: Positioning audit that works without a website: category, ICP and offer analysis, labeled assumptions for everything not stated, a recommended positioning statement and hero copy, and a launch readiness score out of 60. Competitive claims labeled as assumptions unless research was run.
